name: OpenCode Go
author: Andi Wandherd
description: OpenCode Go plan quota, pace, and budget advice in a native Omarchy bar panel — an enhanced agents panel with first-class OpenCode Go support.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: OpenCode Go quota with remaining dollars, reset countdowns, even-pace benchmarks, budget alarms, and behavioral recommendations — plus the classic per-subscription meters.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Panel and notification language. 'auto' follows the system locale (German if it starts with de, English otherwise).

schema.label: Usage popup
schema.description: When On, a desktop notification with the quota figures appears at most once per popup interval. Clicking it opens the panel.

schema.label: Budget-expiry alarm
schema.description: When On, the bar icon lights up when a billing window nears its reset while plenty of budget would go to waste.

schema.label: Graduated meter colors
schema.description: When On, limit meters warm from foreground through amber tones to urgent red as consumption rises. When Off, meters stay foreground until the alarm line.
